reviewer_statement: Author full-source, six-domain native-language semantic review of the frozen Python 1.2 registered mathematical contract lookup. The finite frozen registry consists of 41 exact contract keys and 88 public function aliases. Source-record field names, order, UTF-8 content, and deterministic returned key and metadata were replayed against frozen Python. Python default and keyword call-binding errors, missing/duplicate arguments, unsupported input types, unknown key quoting, NumPy special-size truthiness and the sparse-MFPCA first-lookup branch are matched by explicit Python boundary mode. Native R list and structured conditions are documented language representations instead of live frozen dataclass or Python exception objects. A dedicated expanded direct oracle is scheduled for CI; no unexecuted result is represented as passed, and independent certification is explicitly false. Arbitrary user-defined Python equality objects and Python runtime class identity are out of the native scientific semantic scope.
